_comment: Copy to config.json (gitignored; install.sh and the SD card kit create it). kart_id is a display label only: the Heltec's own id (from its self lines) wins and a mismatch is flagged. pit_urls are tried in order for the map package. beginner_mode hides driver-facing fault alerts only. map_orientation: north_up or heading_up (heading-up applies only while following the own kart). remote_cmd lets other machines POST /cmd (debug only).
